convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorJMomentum indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator call cannot be directly mapped to built-in Python TA libraries.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes sell, sell signal closes buy

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) is the fraction/lot depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses 3-bar ColorJMomentum buffer: Value[0]=current signal bar, Value[1]=bar before that, Value[2]=bar before Value[1]. Long entry: Value[1]>Value[2] (momentum rising) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (still rising). Short entry: Value[1]<Value[2] (momentum falling) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (still falling). SignalBar input (default=1) shifts which bar is used for current signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs act as feature gates to enable/disable each trade direction independently. Signal times are computed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec and passed to trade functions. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit. LoadHistory is called each tick to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorJMomentum indicator must be manually reimplemented in Python. It consists of: 1) Momentum calculation with period MLength, 2) JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing with JMLength and JPhase parameters - both from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory helper functions that handle order execution, margin-based lot sizing, and position management - these must be reimplemented. The entry logic uses a 3-buffer crossover pattern where momentum must be consecutively rising/falling across 3 bars. SignalBar=1 means the analysis is on the 1-bar-ago completed bar, not the current forming bar. MarginMode LOT mode is straightforward (fixed lots), but FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE modes require account equity/margin queries that need adaptation to the Python backtesting framework.
